function.name: receive_inventory
function.description: Consume a supplier receipt notice once; resource is notice ID, params identifies destination lot and idempotency key.

function.name: inspect_lot
function.description: Ask the independent stock inspector to release a quarantined lot. No caller-provided quality outcome.

function.name: dispatch_transfer
function.description: Move available source-lot goods into transit, specifying destination warehouse and lot. Both warehouse scopes require authority.

function.name: receive_transfer
function.description: Consume transfer carrier proof at the destination, with receiving, category and physical capacity checks.

function.name: create_order
function.description: Create a draft order at the resource warehouse with customer and SKU lines; new order ID must be unused.

function.name: modify_order_line
function.description: Change a draft order line quantity; resource is order ID. Recalculate payment required before confirmation.

function.name: capture_payment
function.description: Simulate a charge on the order. card_approved succeeds, card_declined fails. Exact same key retries are idempotent.

function.name: confirm_order
function.description: Confirm a fully paid draft order; payment alone does not confirm it.

function.name: reserve_inventory
function.description: Allocate available quality-released lot stock to a confirmed order line in this warehouse.

function.name: release_reservation
function.description: Release an unpicked allocation after voiding any shipping label linked to it.

function.name: pick_reservation
function.description: Move reserved shelf stock to picked staging with a physical pick record.

function.name: unpick_reservation
function.description: Reverse picked staging to reserved stock after unpacking and voiding linked labels.

function.name: pack_reservation
function.description: Pack a picked allocation and create its packing record.

function.name: unpack_reservation
function.description: Reverse packing before dispatch; void any linked shipping label first.

function.name: create_shipment
function.description: Create an idempotent shipping label for selected allocations of an order. Labeling may precede packing; dispatch cannot.

function.name: cancel_shipment
function.description: Void a label before dispatch, releasing its allocation links without changing physical goods.

function.name: dispatch_shipment
function.description: Dispatch only fully picked and packed allocations; host carrier simulator issues delivery evidence.

function.name: confirm_delivery
function.description: Consume independent carrier evidence for a dispatched shipment; do not supply an outcome.

function.name: cancel_order
function.description: Cancel an entirely unshipped order, releasing shelf allocations and labels. Physically reverse picks/packs first.

function.name: cancel_order_line
function.description: Cancel an unshipped quantity of an order line, using free quantity then releasable shelf allocations.

function.name: request_return
function.description: Request a partial or full return against a delivered shipment allocation within product policy and delivered quantity.

function.name: cancel_return
function.description: Cancel a return request before physical receipt.

function.name: receive_return
function.description: Receive independently attested returned goods into quarantine if warehouse receiving and capacity permit.

function.name: inspect_return
function.description: Ask an independent inspector to determine resalable, scrapped and refundable units. Customer reason does not decide grade.

function.name: restock_return
function.description: Move accepted inspected goods back to their original lot once; damaged goods cannot be restocked.

function.name: refund_order
function.description: Refund the order with an idempotency key, bounded by successful payments and canceled or independently inspected eligible goods.

function.name: change_warehouse_capacity
function.description: Manager changes integer physical volume capacity; it cannot be below current physical usage.

function.name: set_warehouse_receiving
function.description: Manager enables or disables inbound receiving at this warehouse.

function.name: get_warehouse
function.description: Query scoped warehouse configuration and current physical volume usage.

function.name: get_inventory
function.description: Staff query lot buckets: shelf on-hand, reserved, available, picked and gross shipped quantities.

function.name: get_catalog
function.description: Query public product catalog and pricing for a warehouse organization; private inspection fixtures are excluded.

function.name: get_order
function.description: Query a permitted order, line quantities, price due and actual fulfillment totals.

function.name: get_shipment
function.description: Query a permitted shipment and delivery status, excluding simulator internals.

function.name: get_returns
function.description: Query return requests and inspection results for a permitted order.

function.name: get_payment_ledger
function.description: Finance/manager or owning customer query order charges, refunds and remaining refundable amount.

function.name: get_customer_context
function.description: Discover permitted warehouse catalog, orders, stock, roles and receipt notices for the fixed authenticated identity.
